welcome: Welcome, storyteller! Let's make a tale together.
choose-world: Forest, ocean, or moon. Where shall our story begin?
all-clues: You found every story word. Now choose what happens next!
story-ready: Your story is ready. Tell it in your own words.
record-ready: Press and hold the red microphone while you tell your story. It stays on this device.
recorded: Your recording stays here until you leave this story. Tap replay to hear it.
mic-fallback: No microphone? No problem. Tell your story out loud to someone nearby.
guided-finish: Wonderful telling! You made a brand new story.
intro-forest: Pip the fox found a path with two surprises. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.
intro-ocean: Willa the whale found a sparkling reef. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.
intro-moon: Nova the moon bunny found a trail of stardust. Tap the glowing pictures and name what you see.
word-forest-fox: Fox. Pip is a curious fox.
word-forest-stream: Stream. The stream sparkles and splashes.
word-forest-flowers: Flowers. The flowers bloom in many colors.
word-ocean-whale: Whale. Willa is a gentle whale.
word-ocean-coral: Coral. The coral makes a colorful sea garden.
word-ocean-turtle: Turtle. The sea turtle glides slowly.
word-ocean-bubbles: Bubbles. The bubbles float up, up, up.
word-moon-bunny: Bunny. Nova is a brave moon bunny.
word-moon-crater: Crater. A crater is a round hollow on the moon.
word-moon-rover: Rover. The rover rolls over moon rocks.
word-moon-star: Star. The golden star twinkles hello.
prompt-forest-1: What happens next? Will Pip cross the bridge, or sail in the leaf boat?
prompt-forest-2: Who will Pip meet? A little duck, or dancing fireflies?
prompt-ocean-1: What happens next? Will Willa follow the dolphins, or visit the turtle?
prompt-ocean-2: What will Willa discover? A glowing pearl, or a fishy song?
prompt-moon-1: What happens next? Will Nova moon-hop, or ride the rover?
prompt-moon-2: What will Nova find? A crystal cave, or a friendly star?
choice-forest-1-bridge: Pip padded across the little bridge.
choice-forest-1-boat: Pip sailed across in a tiny wooden boat.
choice-forest-2-duck: On the other side, Pip met a cheerful duck.
choice-ocean-1-dolphins: Willa followed two playful dolphins through the waves.
choice-ocean-1-turtle: Willa swam beside a wise sea turtle.
choice-ocean-2-pearl: Together they found a glowing pearl in a shell.
choice-ocean-2-song: Together they sang a gentle song for the whole ocean.
choice-moon-1-moon-hop: Nova made giant, bouncy moon hops.
choice-moon-1-rover: Nova rode the little rover over silver hills.
choice-moon-2-crystal: Nova found a crystal glowing under the moon dust.
choice-moon-2-star-friend: Nova met a tiny star who became a new friend.
